items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: The only difficulty they had is DuBuse Heyward wanted the lyrics to be heard...

ctx.x: No, nothing. Didn't do nothing. He left it to them. They did it. (Inaudible) staged the show. Alexander Smallens conducted the show. The only difficulty they had is DuBose Heyward wanted the lyrics to be heard and he wanted the music soft and Gershwin wanted the music to be heard, so that's sort of a confliction they had but they come out all right. Everything smoothed down nicely.
Did George Gershwin come to rehearsals?
